blocks.content: Use `htmlspecialchars()` when displaying user input, so that a user cannot inject HTML or JavaScript into the page (**XSS**).

theory.title: Good programming style in a project

items: Put repeated code (header, navigation, database connection) in one file and `include` it on each page.
Meaningful names, comments, indentation, constants instead of magic numbers.
Validate all input and handle errors with clear messages.
Test every page with normal, boundary and erroneous data.
